Real quick, the three split cleanly.

Magic Miner 40T, $799, 40 TH/s — cheapest per terahash we sell, but it's Batch 6 pre-sale shipping mid-November.

Harlo B30, $899, 30 TH/s at 360-450W — quietest and lowest draw, also a pre-sale.

KBOX, $800, 22 TH/s at 330W, built in the US with roughly a 19-day lead — the one that actually arrives soonest.

So: can you wait until November, or do you want it running this month?

context.pop: Torn between the Magic (address hidden), GekkoScience KBOX and Harlo B30? I'll tell you which one fits you.
